Tigers have a well-known love for water and often spend time cooling off in ponds, rivers, or pools, especially during hot weather. Unlike most big cats, they’re powerful swimmers and genuinely enjoy playing, bathing, and even hunting in the water. In one particularly amusing moment, a tiger clamped its jaws around a water fountain and stood perfectly still for almost a minute.
